scope: Development-only fixed-GFP HEK293 intronless Flow-seq observed CDS 4-303 structure-increment pilot; no functional untouched access

source_article.title: Codon Usage and Splicing Jointly Influence mRNA Localization

analysis_population.selection: all 152 finalized variant_counts rows; development only

endpoint.name: flowseq_score_r1_only
endpoint.interpretation: R1-assigned HEK293 intronless Flow-seq weighted fluorescence-bin score; not direct RFU or universal expression

features.structure_engine: ViennaRNA 2.7.2 RNA.fold_compound MFE; DNA converted to RNA; 37 C; dangles=0; full observed 300 nt fragment and every contiguous 48 nt window
features.cai_reference: Nine hard-coded human reference sequences in the hash-frozen CAGFN CAI_calculator.py def_refs; pseudocount 0.5 for unused sense codons; ATG/TGG and stop codons excluded from geometric mean; no exception-to-zero conversion
features.metric_boundary: Observed-R1 fragment MFE is not full-CDS MFE, UTR-initiation MFE, EFE, or a causal structure measurement

model.name: ridge
model.feature_standardization: train-fold mean and population standard deviation only
model.outcome_standardization: train-fold mean and population standard deviation only
model.comparison: same folds, model, alpha, fit procedure and all simple features; treatment only adds three structure features

cross_validation.assignment: sort variant_id by SHA256('20261120|'+variant_id), assign rank modulo 5; deterministic development folds
cross_validation.prediction: one out-of-fold prediction per variant; exact CDS uniqueness and no author GFP identity mapping required
cross_validation.leakage_controls: all scaling fitted within each training fold; no feature selection, alpha tuning or checkpoint selection

statistics.success_direction: delta_spearman CI lower bound > 0 and delta_mse CI upper bound < 0, with Holm-adjusted two-sided paired sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 for both
secondary_metrics: Pearson and RMSE for depth-only, simple and simple-plus-structure
statistics.bootstrap: paired variant resampling with replacement; percentile interval for treatment-minus-simple differences
statistics.permutation: paired sign-flip exchange of simple/treatment out-of-fold predictions within variant; two-sided absolute effect; (1+exceedances)/(B+1)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across exactly two primary endpoint hypotheses
